dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular closed-loop 'O' and partial 'C' structures are present with high-contrast, light-tan perimeters. The transition from the dark brown exterior to the light perimeter is sharp, with some loops containing a darker interior core, particularly in the mid-right dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of solid high-intensity cream-colored pixel clusters observed near the bottom-left edge and along the upper-left curvature, characterized by a lack of internal intensity gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of four prominent closed-loop structures in the central-right field of view form an irregular quadrilateral. A secondary tight triangular formation is created by the centroids of three smaller rings located directly below the primary central cluster.
